title: Exact measured resolution search over a supplied finite clause universe
claims: MeasuredUniverseResolution saturates an arbitrary supplied canonical clause universe and emits an exact resolution derivation.
ExactSuppliedUniverseRefutation decides whether a fully represented resolution refutation exists, and SuppliedUniverseRefutationSearch returns a checked canonical witness exactly in that case.
MeasuredResolutionUniverseSAT proves guarded SAT is in P when a measured universe generator covers a refutation for every unsatisfiable guarded input.
TwoSATWidthTwoRefutation establishes bounded-width coverage for unsatisfiable width-two formulas and MeasuredTwoSATResolutionSearch returns their exact refutations.

experiments.purpose: Bind all archived Lean overlay sources and the recorded exact statements to the local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports its live Lean invocation count, which may be zero.
